reviews.author: Kitty VP
reviews.text: I am 100% impressed with this man. He seemed to be honest and I like that in a mechanic. He test drove my vehicle to let me know what was wrong with it and I left my Personal belongings in the vehicle and they weren’t even touched thank you very much for that by the way! So to me that tells me this man is a very honest man, and can’t wait to do future business with him. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Madty H
reviews.text: I highly recommend him if anyone needing a mechanic! He solved some issues on my car and also gave me a lot of information! Great service ! my car is driving good!

reviews.author: Myanmar Waidan
reviews.text: I was going through some pretty extreme personal issues, and my car had been sabotaged by my ex. I couldn’t even tell what had been done to the vehicle and was feeling pretty hopeless about resolving the issue in time for me to be able to go to work and take my kids to school. Ken was the ultimate professional and assured me he would figure out what was wrong, what would be needed, and quoted me a very fair price for his time. He was very positive as well and it was a pleasure working with him. I will certainly be retaining him for any future repairs I need and would highly recommend his services to anyone looking for knowledge, skills, experience, and professionalism.

reviews.author: Ashanti Lewis
reviews.text: Ken was very reasonable & kind with his services.. he was very transparent about everything & he helps you understand exactly what is wrong with your car & what all is needed. he fixed my problems very quickly. i’ll definitely be going to him from now on for any further car services!

reviews.author: Cody Rice
reviews.text: Had some front end suspension work done. Ken was very informative and communicated well throughout the process. He beat the price of several competitors that I called around to.

reviews.author: Barbara Edens
reviews.text: Recently called Ken for a possible muffler repair. He came out, looked & diagnosed it as a Y pipe & after he got the part, came right back the following week & installed it. Great guy. Very professional & very reasonable. And he comes to you! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Melanie Stiksma
reviews.text: I was so thankful Ken was able to take a look at my van quickly. He figured out what was wrong and got me back on the road quick. It was so convenient to have him come to me! Very reasonably priced service.

reviews.author: Siri Ot
reviews.text: Dealership told me it was a thermostat. Told me they where certain it was the problem. It was not that, Ken came out the same day even though I called at 5pm diagnosed the problem as a battery, told me he would be back tomorrow. Came back the next day put the new one in. Fixed my problem and saved me over 500 dollars compared to the Dealership. He's very affordable and earned a customer for life.

reviews.author: Lisa Barlow
reviews.text: What a great mechanic! He’s got my business! Best part…he comes to you. No dropping off and calling to see if it’s ready! He’s reliable and affordable! Just a great guy!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Moats
reviews.text: Called him up earlier this year when my car wouldn't start and I go to him for all the regular maintenance now. Super professional, friendly and I am not worried about him selling me something that isn't needed to up the bill.

reviews.author: Marc Chandler
reviews.text: Ken does awesome work, he cares about the job he does and is by far one of the most knowledgeable and sincere guys I’ve ever met. He’s always been upfront and honest, I would recommend him to anyone needing auto service!

reviews.author: Brandy Wren
reviews.text: Ken has had me up and running in no time! Best part…he came to me and I didn’t have a tow bill! Fast and friendly service that didn’t break my bank account!

reviews.author: Jesse Ashley
reviews.text: Awesome experience. Took care of my alternator quick and fast and very reasonable price. Try him out.

reviews.author: Scott Nickels
reviews.text: Known Ken for over a year. Very thorough, knowledgeable and polite. He cares about the quality of work and customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: Kala Prince
reviews.text: Super nice guy! Knew exactly what he was doing and didnt take him long at all! thank you!! definitely recommend

reviews.author: Haven Adams
reviews.text: Very polite into the point he knows what he’s doing and stands behind his work what more could you ask!
